overview: The Manipur Startup Policy is a state-level initiative aimed at fostering innovation and entrepreneurship within Manipur. It seeks to create a supportive ecosystem for startups by providing financial, infrastructural, and regulatory assistance. The policy focuses on promoting technology-driven ventures and encouraging youth participation in entrepreneurial activities. It aligns with national startup goals while addressing regional challenges and opportunities.
objectives: Promote innovation and entrepreneurship in Manipur
Support technology-driven startups with financial and infrastructural aid
Encourage youth and women participation in startup ecosystem
Simplify regulatory processes for startup establishment and operation
Create incubation and mentorship facilities for early-stage ventures
Facilitate access to funding through government and private partnerships
Strengthen industry-academia collaboration for research and development
Monitor and evaluate startup performance for policy improvement
eligibility: Startups registered in Manipur as private limited companies, LLPs, or partnership firms, incorporated within the last 7 years, with annual turnover not exceeding INR 25 crores, and working on innovative products, services, or processes with potential for scalability and employment generation.
benefits: Financial support in the form of seed funding, grants, or equity-based assistance; access to incubation centers with infrastructure and mentorship; regulatory facilitation including single-window clearance; tax and duty exemptions as per state provisions; participation in state-organized startup events and networking opportunities; guidance on intellectual property rights and legal compliance.
financial_support: The policy provides financial support through seed funding of up to INR 10 lakhs per startup in the form of grants or convertible equity, disbursed via the State Innovation and Startup Fund. Additional support may include matched funding from government schemes and access to venture capital networks.
application_process: 1. Register on the official Manipur Startup Policy portal. 2. Submit the online application form with business details and innovation description. 3. Upload required documents including Certificate of Incorporation, PAN, and pitch deck. 4. Await preliminary screening by the State Startup Committee. 5. Present the business model before the selection panel for evaluation. 6. Receive approval and disbursement of funds upon successful selection.
required_documents: Bank account details of the entity
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year.
implementing_agency: Department of Information Technology, Government of Manipur
caveats: Funding is subject to availability of budget and government approvals
Startups must maintain registration and operational status in Manipur to avail benefits
Misuse of funds may lead to recovery and blacklisting
Benefits are contingent upon meeting milestones and submission of progress reports
